results.title: Caught in the Crackdown
results.overview: FRONTLINE and ProPublica trace the violence, protests and arrests stemming from federal immigration sweeps across the United States. The documentary examines the tactics, legal cases and impact — from Los Angeles to Chicago to Minneapolis.

results.title: Winter Lions
results.overview: Opening with a tragic crime, whose perpetrator attempts to hide his tracks, including his relationship to people in power and organized crime. The father of the victim – his daughter – who thought he had left behind a life marked by violence, decides to seek justice on his own, crossing red lines from which there is no return. If there is anything more dangerous than a father defending his children, is a father who no longer has any children to defend.

results.title: Anfa 8
results.overview: In the city of Soli, ruled by Anfa 8, where night is eternal, Horus hunts a renegade cult of solar worshippers who are desperately searching for the sun.

results.title: Chocolate for Christmas
results.overview: When a woman returns home to save her family’s beloved chocolate shop, she finds unexpected love and a renewed appreciation for what matters most. This sweet holiday romance celebrates family, community and the lasting power of tradition.

results.title: Plantman & Blondie: A Dress Up Gang Film
results.original_title: Plantman & Blondie: A Dress Up Gang Film
results.overview: A lonely man escapes working from home when he meets Plantman...a mysterious man saving the neglected house plants of Los Angeles.

results.title: Let Dan Go
results.overview: Several years after the car accident that took his son Dan's life, his father Harry, still grieving, reconnects with Dan's girlfriend Abby to celebrate Dan's life and reconcile their loss.

results.title: Paul Smith: Pablo Live
results.overview: From one of the UK’s most viral stand-up comedians, in his debut special, “Paul Smith: Pablo Live” is the show you’ve all been waiting for. Filmed live at the 3Olympia Theatre in Dublin, it’s packed full of Smith’s signature, unflinching, laugh out loud comedy. Featuring a mix of his trademark audience roasting, razor-sharp wit and hilarious true stories of his everyday life, from spending money in the most irresponsible way possible, why boys are better than girls and raising kids without leading by example, this is the full, unfiltered Paul Smith experience, and you won't want to miss a minute of it.

results.title: Gora rocka
results.overview: The documentary film Gora Rocka takes viewers to the heart of one of Slovenia’s most unique festivals - an event that has spent over two decades demonstrating that music can bring people together while simultaneously transforming the community. Through energetic concert highlights and personal stories, the film reveals the behind-the-scenes world of the Gora Rocka festival on the Šentviška Planota plateau in the Tolmin region. It is a charity rock festival co-created annually by over 360 volunteers, with all proceeds dedicated to helping the local community and individuals in need.

results.title: Amyl and The Sniffers Live at Ally Pally
results.original_title: Amyl and The Sniffers Live at Ally Pally
results.overview: Filmed live at Alexandra Palace on Saturday 25 October 2025.

results.title: All Rivers Spill Their Stories to the Sea
results.original_title: All Rivers Spill Their Stories to the Sea
results.overview: On England’s North East coast, where rivers, heavy industry and the sea have shaped lives for generations, fisherman Stan Rennie is watching the world he knows disappear. His family have worked these waters for generations. Then, almost overnight, thousands of dead crabs and lobsters wash ashore, and a community already living with uncertainty is pushed into crisis. Teesside filmmaker Jeanie Finlay brings warmth, wit and deep local feeling to this David-and-Goliath story of environmental damage, official evasions and working-class resilience. At its centre is Stan: funny, stubborn, vulnerable and increasingly determined to be heard.

results.title: Pain in the Neck
results.overview: After the apocalypse hits Hollywood, Ruby’s acting career is dead, her landlord’s a chatty zombie, and her roommate, Helena, is a vampire that drinks her blood in exchange for protection. As the two big personalities clash, Ruby and Helena struggle through self-tapes, jealousy, and sharing a bedroom. Ruby and Helena’s arrangement should be simple– it shouldn’t involve falling in love.

results.title: Something Still
results.overview: A heartbroken man returns to the home he shared with his ex-boyfriend, where visceral memories force him to confront the fissures that led to their parting: when the 'casual threesome' they planned evolved into something more.

results.title: Alechenu
results.overview: Autistic 13-year-old, ALECHENU, journeys from his village in Oyo to the large city of Lagos with a picture and backpack, in hopes of finding a mother he has never met.

results.title: Mukhbir: The Story of a Spy - The Movie
results.original_title: मुखबिर: द स्टोरी ऑफ अ स्पाई - द मूवी
results.overview: After the Sino-Indian war, a highly trained Indian spy enters Pakistan on a mission to gather crucial intelligence and stop Pakistan from launching an attack against India. Will he succeed?

results.title: The Soulless
results.overview: Two high-school bookworms lure their bullies into a forest to expel the bad from their souls, only to end up face to face with something far worse.
